title: Add integration event before inserting the outgoing IC sales line buffer
summary: An integration event now fires before each outgoing intercompany sales line buffer is inserted, allowing extensions to enrich line data before it enters the API payload.
key_points: New event OnPostICSalesLineToICPartnerInboxOnBeforeBufferICInboxSalesLineInsert fires per sales line
Event fires after TransferFields and before buffer insert in the outgoing IC flow
Mirrors existing before-insert events for sales and purchase headers
Extensions can now enhance outgoing IC sales lines at the API level
Additive change with no impact on existing logic or data
quote: extensions can enrich each outgoing sales line before it reaches the API payload
